posts.headline: Thicks and Klint's Clipboard are 3-0 now, but this column has doubted the champ for TEN straight editions and I'm not stopping until 403.68 points looks like a coronation instead of a stroll.
posts.detail: A title and a 14-14 career record buys you nothing here — 3-0 is nice, but that's the same guy who's finished as low as 8th in this league. Prove it in Week 4.

posts.headline: Eleven straight editions of burying Put it in Ra, and now it's officially 0-3 — One Nut Barner's 20-8, 1.5-average-finish resume is a full-blown archaeological dig.
posts.detail: This is the same GM who owns the league's best career winning percentage at .714, and he's sitting at 348.4 points for with nothing to show but goose eggs. The crater keeps getting deeper.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 3-0 with a league-best 499.94 points, and this column is now on day NINE demanding respect for triciagloston that this league refuses to give.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career record didn't predict this — she's outscoring the entire league by nearly 80 points over Klint's Clipboard's total, and still nobody's talking about it.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-3 with a league-worst 233.78 points, and Auntie Thomas's 10-average-finish resume is proving to be a floor, not a fluke.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record was already unimpressive, and now three straight losses to open the year have this roster looking like the same old bottom-feeder right on schedule.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT falls to 0-3, and the Ultimate Light Skin's plague has now spread across an eighth straight edition of judgment.
posts.detail: The man who drafted a defensive player first overall is watching his 13-14-1 career record get worse by the week with 329.04 points for — the belt keeps winning, Eli.
